question: In Δ ABC, D and E are points on sides AB and BC, respectively, such that DE ∥ AC. If BD = 4sqrt 6 and AB = 12sqrt 3 cm, then the ratio of the area of Δ BDE to that of quadrilateral ACED is:
solution:
**Concept:**

The area of similar triangles is proportional to the square of their corresponding sides. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6296ccdf74456617fb2e1c0480b56b2c9e2ef8dd24b4ad76f4a3074506dc46.png] 

In the figure, ΔADE ~ ΔABC.

⇒ AD²over AB² = ar ΔADEover ar Δ ABC

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a70435d45f8e0c59408ac3a8eb09fac8f3d983afa792c28ffe78808e677b3a5.png] 

In the figure, ΔBDE ~ ΔABC (AAA criterion)

⇒ BD²over AB² = ar ΔBDEover ar Δ ABC

⇒ ar ΔBDEover ar Δ ABC = (4sqrt6)²over (12sqrt3)² = 96over 432

From the figure, area of quadrilateral ACED = ar ABC - ar BDE

Area of quadrilateral ACED = 432 cm2 - 96 cm2 = 336 cm²

According to the question

⇒frac{{{{Area}} Δ {{BDE}}}}{{{{Area}} {{of}} {{quadrilateral}} {{ACED}}}} = 96over 336 = 2 ∶ 7

∴ **The answer is 2 ∶ 7.**
